Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is a dynamic and innovation-driven high-tech enterprise headquartered at No. 136 Qingchun Road in the vibrant city of Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province—China’s hub for technological advancement and ecological manufacturing. Founded with a vision to bridge cutting-edge chemistry with sustainable industrial application, Runhe specializes in the research, development, production, and commercialization of advanced functional chemical new materials. Its core product portfolio encompasses high-performance water-based resins, environmentally compliant coatings and adhesives, specialty intermediates for electronics and automotive sectors, and green catalysts designed to meet stringent global regulatory standards—including China’s "Dual Carbon" goals (carbon peak and carbon neutrality) and EU REACH/ROHS directives.

Leveraging strong R&D capabilities supported by a dedicated team of PhDs and senior chemical engineers, the company operates modern GMP-compliant production facilities equipped with automated synthesis, precision analytical labs (e.g., GC-MS, FT-IR, DSC), and rigorous quality control systems certified to ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 standards. Runhe serves a diversified clientele across packaging, construction, electronics, renewable energy, and biomedical industries—both domestically and internationally—through strategic partnerships with OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers. Committed to green chemistry principles, the company emphasizes solvent reduction, energy-efficient processes, and recyclable material design. With Hangzhou’s robust innovation ecosystem and proximity to key ports and universities (e.g., Zhejiang University), Runhe continues to accelerate its transformation into a leading, responsible player in China’s new materials industry—synthesizing scientific excellence, environmental stewardship, and industrial pragmatism.
